DECIDED 2026-08-20 — built into index.html:

B's plum masthead + Bricolage display for the marketing surface.
A's cool paper, Plex Mono values and range-scale for the report surface.

B's script wall was built, then removed: five scripts in the hero read as clutter to someone trying to understand their own result.

C was NOT used as a look. Its strip chart WAS taken: the report now carries a panel map, every value with a printed range plotted against it, furthest-out first.
